frozen_before: the first nudge sample of any unit
q_lik_floor: algorithms of S without a verified forced program get no score; q_lik(a) = (p(a) * M + 1) / (M + |S|) with p = softmax(score_tok) over the scored algorithms of S and M = number of scored programs among S; qlik_top1 = argmax over scored algorithms (None if none)
q_lik_sensitivity_references: reported beside: none (references are not instruct-authored)
engine_check: JS of label compositions vs the 95th percentile of a template-stratified bootstrap null (1,000 reps, default_rng(20261021)); twin: HF k 0-9 vs vLLM k 10-19; base (iteration-5 units): iteration-5 chat rows vs new BASEX k 40-49
twin_baseline: T 1.0 twin: HF CRN k 0-9 + vLLM k 10-39 when the twin engine check passes, else HF k 0-9 only
escape_share: correct S-labelled programs / all programs of the cell
landing_event_cells: ESC: every qualifying cell (N 10 or N 30); PN: alpha 2 and 4 qualifying cells; GTN: alpha 2 qualifying cell; BINT: its single cell (content_free = false)
margin_rule: modal landing must lead the next algorithm by >= 15 percentage points of the pooled S-labelled correct programs, else NO_CLEAR_LANDING
replacement_class: 1 if r_u is a library/one-line mode (src/quantities6.LIB_ONE_LINE) or the twin tail already contains a correct r_u program, else 0
runtime_merit: log2(sum of the default reference's median stress-case times / min over S of the same), from the unit build's 5-run (iteration 5) or 3-run (panel II) median timings
BINT_engine: BINT code generation is unhooked and runs on vLLM bf16 (not HF CRN); base intents are not resampled when invalid (validity flagged)
screen_E_u: B units: iteration-6 escape definition recomputed from vendored rows; A units: iteration-5 published cells
